## Current status — 2026-10-16, Unit7 delivered

R9 Unit7 completed the theory and local coding loops for physical bridges parallel to the external calculation. Independent decision: **PASS_SCOPED_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_ALL_THREE_LANES_AND_A2**.

- **T6 Li I response:** provider-prescribed 1s/2s branches close the prior64.39eV coverage gap for the saved sources. For LiIII two-photon continuum, completed event/absorbed-energy responses are3.815889/10.640974 times the former covered-band values. Actual6608 E1 lines are now connected: their event-response fractions in the four LiIII mixtures are96.6468%–99.6095%. Conditional direct absorption and primary kinetic-energy bookkeeping are separate from thermal deposition, relaxation yields and actual cosmological illumination.
- **T7 early Be7 kinetics:** the actual BBN donor and explicit thermal FLRW background yield z10/z50/z90=31203.45894/29307.17654/28211.33004. Positive two-state propagation plus independent Radau comparisons took0.84048s total numerical time. This is a computed early history under frozen trace-bath assumptions; later Li charge evolution/native17 remain open.
- **Decay spectrum:** conservative redshift mapping gives two dn/dE modes29.74984/13.26281eV and Be7-component present number density9.38379e-17cm^-3. Independent kinetic-profile moment agreement is about0.1043%; roundoff-level bin conservation is not global spectral accuracy. Gamma/recoil outputs are source energies, not deposited heat.
- **Validation:** A1 nine focused checks; A2 eight focused checks; B13 numerical gates plus2 unit tests; C8 numerical gates plus3 unit tests. These are distinct categories. Original test/fixture/plot failures and correction sequence remain preserved. Wolfram calls failed internally; native Fortran oracle was not run because no compiler was present. No success is claimed for either route.

The external T4 state is unchanged: the earlier actual16/32/64 run was PARTIAL_WALL_LIMIT with refinement HOLD. This unit performed zero physical Hamiltonian and NCP actions, and did not inspect the external process. No newer128 result was supplied at intake. All eight complete physical programmes remain open; this unit closes the explicitly listed local dependencies.

Delivery:
- [Unit7 report, source, inputs, actual CSV results and figure](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/tree/9f455d98e2dd655412b561defff9e41e31dbb50a/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit7_physical_bridges_20261016)
- [Updated eight-programme DAG](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/9f455d98e2dd655412b561defff9e41e31dbb50a/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit7_physical_bridges_20261016/progress/DAG.md)
- [Final delivery receipt and stage mapping](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/9f455d98e2dd655412b561defff9e41e31dbb50a/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit7_physical_bridges_20261016/progress/DELIVERY_FINAL.json)
- [Full113-file archive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/14s_Tb60kG3IAsTxC93iX0g2mbpDujX0K/view),8,270,620bytes,SHA256 f93abd2d5a7053e669c5c913663a3c4e574ea62b271e34d5618935cc049c09de.

Both S1 and S2 have confirmed Dropbox/Drive completion and matching metadata sizes. Local SHA256 is recorded; provider checksums were not returned and archive download byte readback was not performed. Eight critical published text files were fetched and exactly compared; four large-file Git blob IDs match local Git-object hashes. Each R1–R10/C1–C10 step is mapped to a shared checkpoint, not claimed as a separate upload. Five lane-B raw NPZ arrays are full-backup-only; public CSV/results and complete portable inputs/code remain sufficient to inspect and reproduce the calculations.

Additive publication only; draft status and base branch preserved. No extra NCP handoff is required for this completed local unit.

## Earlier Unit6 and programme history

The following snapshots are retained as history. Their prior LiI coverage and conditional-only early Be7 statements are superseded by Unit7 above; earlier external execution statements retain their dated scope.

## Current status — 2026-10-16, Unit6 delivered

R9 Unit6 completed three lightweight units independently of the external Hamiltonian calculation. Independent decision: **PASS_SCOPED_LOCAL_IMPLEMENTATION_ALL_THREE_LANES**, with **18 focused tests passed** (8 residual QR, 4 two-photon, 6 EC), no substantive findings or repairs.

- **T4 cached residual QR:** preserves the Unit5 residual/bound definition. One N512/m32 synthetic comparison took 0.13205 s direct versus 0.01160 s QR (11.38 ratio). Actual-checkpoint performance is NOT_MEASURED; this unit performed zero physical H/NCP actions.
- **T6 two-photon completion:** C99 kernel and actual 32 saved E1 mixtures across eight species. Maximum energy closure residual 1.42e-14 eV. Literature-fit/reduced-mass approximations remain explicit. LiIII emission above the LiI fit coverage is retained with unknown absorption response.
- **T7 Be7 EC:** all eight no-shakeoff charge channels, 22-population auxiliary adapter, exact prescribed-hazard events and actual-donor conditional exposures/Be3 clock. Physical heat remains null pending energy partition; no native17 or self-consistent cosmological history is claimed.

Unit4's earlier NOT_RUN status below is historical: actual16/32/64 NCP results were recovered and published at 7e07012a6d2030699c698a7209a9100bd04578d2. Reconstruction and internal numerical gates passed; the run was PARTIAL_WALL_LIMIT and spectrum/CDF refinement remains HOLD. No128 result was obtained in that run. Unit5 resume/postprocessing implementation was subsequently locally validated at edead5026fdcc4217a9caec5106f7839c6aec5a5; implementation readiness is separate from actual execution. At Unit6 intake no newer Unit5 execution result was posted on this branch; the external process state was not inspected.

Delivery:
- [Unit6 report, code, exact inputs and text/CSV evidence](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/tree/06c9c8ed1d31d4e08059ed6706938bb9b68a6559/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit6_parallel_20261016)
- [Eight-programme DAG](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/06c9c8ed1d31d4e08059ed6706938bb9b68a6559/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit6_parallel_20261016/progress/DAG.md)
- [Final delivery receipt and twenty-step completion](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/blob/232df074d97cd699238db891ca015caef12a82ea/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit6_parallel_20261016/progress/DELIVERY_FINAL.json)
- [Complete81-file archive](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1p-1LNePsdtIQKF1t81GLU6kQFpDwzHt2/view), 1,206,778 bytes, SHA256 10fd6069c215d0e82e3740c505b635a4084dfbcd710f079efda16c5521534d7f.

S1 theory/design and S2 execution/review each have confirmed Dropbox and Drive backups. Final archive verification was provider completion/upload acknowledgment plus matching metadata sizes; provider checksums were not returned and download byte readback was not performed. Core published code, report, DAG and final review were fetched and exactly compared with local text. Individual R1–R10/C1–C10 steps link to their shared immutable checkpoints; separate uploads for each step are not claimed.

All eight complete physical programmes remain open. This PR remains additive and draft; no production activation or merge.

## Historical progress record

The following earlier snapshot is preserved for history. Its Unit4 NOT_RUN statement and next-action wording are superseded by the dated current status above.

Continue the eight-task research program using actual 64-core/125-GiB NCP calculations and pinned PR150/HE64/HH89/CR71 inputs.

Unit1 is committed on this branch: 56 solver receipts (53 accepted finite-model calculations, 3 preserved failures), bounded nuclear/cascade/inventory/source calculations, and independent review. Its raw archive was verified on Drive and Dropbox; see UNIT1_DELIVERY.json.

Unit2 is committed at 57e6e2d79c1a1ea4786d83b36c871abf581be738 and its Drive/Dropbox archive, PDF and TeX backups are complete. The combined snapshot contains 83 solver receipts: 77 accepted finite-model calculations and 6 failed/deferred attempts. Independent review checked all 24 newly accepted NPZ files. The current recovery also verified all 77 saved NPZ hashes against their receipts.

Actual prior NCP Rust verification: rustc 1.99.0 and cargo 1.99.0; locked offline native-library check succeeded; all 8 deuterium_atomic integration tests passed. The earlier library-only filter that ran zero tests is not counted.

Deliverables:
- [Unit2 English PDF report, 10 pages](https://drive.google.com/file/d/15EuytSPKy9abpvJp2AJy7YrnrHQ6H5E4/view)
- [Unit2 LaTeX source](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1j1Va-GPdw-8fDTDF0Q4FnzEoAPGzcGnX/view)
- [Original full Unit2 archive, 43,479,461 bytes](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1k2xnvrxMvUaQpTOGp-3K0dlrHNoQuIJT/view)
- [New complete NCP handoff archive, 43,601,197 bytes / 755 files](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a9SxVdcJBup_zrgbcNmlIyxOXx6joW5J/view)
- [Standalone Korean Codex handoff prompt](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1S5UX6tLnvr5P-3G_bXhJ9mST0K1FQhEc/view)
- [Executable handoff and evidence at 903d72c](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/tree/903d72c3405c544f31f83d009384313b1a70553b/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/handoff_20261016)

C10 publication: the full new archive and standalone prompt are saved to both Drive and Dropbox. Uploaded Dropbox files were downloaded and byte-compared to local originals; Drive upload acknowledgements and metadata sizes match. Drive byte-level readback was not performed. Archive SHA256: 1247d0be653afd72099773d640a51b7ebbbfb4ed49c0e7855f13e1ecc6dbcdf1. See handoff_20261016/HANDOFF_DELIVERY.json and BACKUP_VERIFICATION.json.

C10 implementation: inspect/collect only, no automatic solver replay. Seventeen local fixture tests and the final packaged layout passed; independent review is PASS_FOR_PACKAGING_AND_NCP_INSPECT_COLLECT. The four bounded review findings in malformed-evidence handling, stopped-conflict preservation, real supervisor detection and run-manifest collection were repaired. These checks do not establish current NCP execution or physical convergence.

Unit3 recovery is COMPLETE-SUCCESS as inspected at 2026-10-15 23:03 UTC and published at 284916e758d87852a6137fbbb36befe83f15d271. The aug-TZ Li→Be+ calculation itself completed at 15:50:09 UTC (4932.148 s, peak 8.8232 GiB). Recovery passed 86/86 frozen gates with no matching process or inspection gap. Actual restored NPZ arrays were checked again in Unit4: 92 orbitals, 385112 determinants, P_ground=0.5756391820077925 and unresolved complement W=0.42436081799220793. The earlier collector failure was a publication dependency failure; its historical UNKNOWN status is superseded by this actual recovery. Original-H residuals, AO metric and spin remain solver-reported, not independently recomputed from the integral-free archive. The independent PR150 owner campaign was left untouched.

Unit4 is published at d3fd3d6fdb55dc4af8e93696a7dcafdb10cb76db under unit4_t4_spectral_20261016. Actual saved-state diagnostics give conditional complement mean 2.668210343338318 Eh and variance 17.0964554807787 Eh² in the exact-ground limit. The recorded daughter residual bounds the conditional mean to [2.6682102257664715, 2.6682104609101644] Eh, conditional on the archived moments/residual and up to rounding; this is not a basis-error interval. Derivations, primary-source notes and Wolfram checks are included.

The complete projected-Lanczos runner reconstructs the same Be+ Hamiltonian from saved expanded AO shells and X using frozen V6 raw_action, without repeating SCF or ground-state FCI. It uses one nested 16→32→64 chain (128 only when needed), direct moment/Gram/leakage checks and independent Lorentzian spectrum/CDF refinement. Limits are 12 threads, 24 GiB, 7200 seconds, 160 Hamiltonian actions, with checkpoints and partial-result preservation. Nine dense/supervisor tests passed, the packaged input summary passed, and fresh independent review accepted local implementation and bounded NCP execution readiness.

Actual Unit4 NCP reconstruction and 92-orbital spectral execution remain NOT_RUN_REMOTE_UNAVAILABLE. Local tests do not establish PySCF-backend or physical-spectrum convergence. The remote connector monthly quota is exhausted; the next executable action is local Codex running the included NCP prompt.

- [Full Unit4 package, 9,219,469 bytes / 65 files](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1h8b044Pia3JfM_tvL4IMTKeNN4YnrXGt/view)

- [Unit4 code, contract, review and results](https://github.com/cosmosapjw-quantum/rei_bianchi/tree/d3fd3d6fdb55dc4af8e93696a7dcafdb10cb76db/research/microphysics_r9_20261015/unit4_t4_spectral_20261016)

Unit4 archive SHA256: 91977313e1004be22a540b1fd2b874ded4d437301b1f61e9ff54d59cbbda275b. Full archive and standalone prompt are saved to both Drive and Dropbox; Dropbox byte readbacks and content hashes match local originals. Drive upload acknowledgements and metadata sizes match; Drive byte readback was not performed. See Unit4 PUBLICATION.md and BACKUP_VERIFICATION.json.

Physical limits remain explicit: core-valence ionization T-to-Q change 3.49970822e-4 Eh and He/Li projection change 2.72459345e-4 both miss their selected targets. Response TRK values 1.11125914/1.65647443 remain below 3 despite Krylov convergence. BO curves are not reaction rates, conditional BBN/source maps are not evolved cosmological trajectories, and all 8 full physical programmes remain open.

Changes are additive under research/microphysics_r9_20261015. The existing checkout branch and unrelated work are preserved. No merge or production activation.
